messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

Hi Arthur, your order is paid and nothing has shipped yet, and I'm sorry, the October 30 date I gave you didn't hold.

Where it stands: your Harlo B30 is in batch 1, which left the factory on October 15. The U. units are landing at our Chattanooga warehouse now. The P. Kit is already reserved there, and both go out in one box as soon as the B30 is checked in.

You can follow that shipment here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Tracking emails to you automatically the moment the label is made.
